# ScaleMatrix AI

> ScaleMatrix AI is an AI lead generation and outreach agency. We build automated outbound engines that source decision-makers in a client's market, send personalized outreach, handle replies with AI, and book qualified sales meetings into the client's Google or Outlook calendar. No ad spend, cold calling or extra sales hires required.

## What we do
- Hyper-targeted sourcing: map companies and decision-makers matching the client's ideal customer profile, industry and territory.
- AI personalization engine: tailored outreach for each prospect's company size and location.
- Instant inbound booking: AI handles replies and places meetings straight into the client's calendar.

## Who it is for
Growing B2B and service businesses selling high-value contracts, such as commercial cleaning, facility management and solar companies.

## Expected outcomes
Target: 10-15 qualified sales meetings per month, first qualified meeting within about 14 days. Results depend on offer, market and territory and are not guaranteed.
